name: zn15_08_09_cell_mapping
description: Conformance tests 8 and 9 (the cell-mapping helpers). Test 8 (GetOccupantLot cells, §8.2 slot 14): per axis a := r24(p × 0.0625), c := rhe(r24(a − 0.5)), c := c + 1 when a = c + 1 exactly, so c = floor(p / 16). Positions (x): 112.0 -> 7; 104.0 -> 6; 15.99 -> 0; -0.01 -> -1 (a cell below 0, so GetLot returns null). Test 9 (GetLotSavvyTerrainAltitude cells, §8.7 slot 18): c := rhe(r24(r24(x × 0.0625) − 0.499)) with 0.499 = 0x3EFF7CEE = 0.49900001, before the clamp. x = 15.98 -> 0; 15.99 -> 1; 16.0 -> 1; -8.0 -> -1 (clamped to 0 by the caller); 127.99 -> 8. The rounding quirk: x/16 with a fraction above 0.999 rounds up (15.99 -> 1).
